app.name: Thekra
app.description: Reminders from the Quran, authentic Sunnah, and the words of scholars, arranged by sins, good deeds, and the branches of faith, with each text's source named.
app.intentionReminder: I want nothing from this except Allah.

about.lead: Every book named, every narration graded.
about.intro: Thekra cites the book and the person who graded a narration. A book is never given one grade for every hadith in it.
about.methodologyBody: Every text names its source. A verse shows its surah and ayah; a hadith shows its book, number, and the grade given by the authority that graded it. Quoted words stay distinct from any explanation Thekra adds.
about.openitiBody: Digital texts imported from OpenITI are used under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 licence. Attribution: OpenITI. Thekra does not sell this text and does not run ads on it. If the dataset is shared, it stays under the same licence.

setup.chooseLead: Start with one or two. Keeping a little going matters more than doing a lot.
setup.allChosen: You have added every available habit.
setup.calmSelection: You chose more than two. Settle what you have first, then add others once they are steady.
setup.shapeLead: Choose a very small start, two times a day to be reminded, and how many days a week. The other days are for making up.
setup.distanceQuestion: Are you close to this habit right now, or far from it?
setup.shapeHint: Two times or more are better: if the first passes, the second catches it. At the start, 3 days a week is enough.
setup.rolesLead: Obligations and the rights of those around you come first: parents, family, work and home. After them, how many minutes a day are left for you?
setup.freeMinutesHint: Usually between 120 and 300 minutes (two to five hours).
setup.loadOver: Your plans take more than half of your free time. Lighten or postpone a habit so that extra deeds do not crowd out your duties.

errors.minutes: Enter a number of minutes from 0 to 1440.

today.partialError: Enter a whole number above zero.
today.increaseOffer: You have held this amount for a month. If you wish, go one small step up to {amount}, or stay as you are.
today.relapse: You have been away for some days, and that is fine. Come back with a smaller amount, {amount}, then build again calmly.
today.seasonOn: Ramadan mode until {date}; then your plan returns to what it was, and that is no shortcoming.
today.seasonOffer: In Ramadan you can raise it for now to {amount}; your plan returns by itself afterwards.
today.ebbOff: Lighter now, back to my plan
today.ebbHint: On heavy days, lighten rather than stop: only the smallest amount is asked.
today.ebbActive: Your habits are at their smallest amount. Keep the obligations, and come back when it lightens.
today.loadOver: Your plans take more than half of your free time. Lighten or postpone a habit so that extra deeds do not crowd out your duties.

leaveSin.title: A program to leave a sin
leaveSin.lead: A staged program on your device: know the harm, build the alternative, change your surroundings, set limits, stay firm.
leaveSin.privacy: This program lives on your device: it is never sent to a server in readable form, never used in any statistics, and the sin is never named in the page title or its link. If you choose to save it to your account, it is sent encrypted with a code only you know.

choose.title: Choose the program
choose.veryHardNo: No, I can leave it now
choose.peopleRights: This wrongs other people: there is no gradual path. It is left, or lightened with real effort, together with restoring rights, and the program helps you with that.
choose.cutOnly: Here the program is for leaving it, helped by means and alternatives.

program.pathGradual: A gradual path: going step by step does not lift the sin, but it lessens the harm step by step until you leave it.
program.pathCut: Leaving path: leave it now; the program helps with means and alternatives.
program.pathPeople: People’s rights: leave it or lighten it with real effort, and return rights to their owners.
program.stageRule: Each stage lasts at least {days} days; you move on when you check in on most days of the week.
program.alternativesTitle: Good habits to put in its place
program.alternativesLead: Start one of them in “My good deeds”, with a small amount.
program.summaryNote: Counts only, with no streaks and no comparison. What matters is coming back every time.

end.lead: Want to close this program alone? Its check-ins and notes are removed, and your other programs stay as they are.
end.confirmBody: Its check-ins and notes are removed from this device now, and from the encrypted copy in your account on its next save if you use one. You can start it again whenever you wish.

checkIn.title: How was your day?
checkIn.note: Private note (optional, no one but you can read it)

errors.noteLong: The note is longer than 500 characters.

wipe.title: Delete all program data
wipe.lead: Removes the programs, check-ins and notes from this device at once; they cannot be recovered.
wipe.confirmBody: Everything will be removed from this device now.
wipe.leadAccount: Removes the programs, check-ins and notes from this device at once, and deletes the encrypted copy from your account. They cannot be recovered.
wipe.confirmBodyAccount: Everything will be removed from this device now, and the encrypted copy deleted from your account.
wipe.remoteFailed: This device is cleared, but the encrypted copy could not be deleted from your account.

vault.title: Saving to your account
vault.guest: The program is on this device only. Sign in to save it encrypted in your account and open it on another device.
vault.offer: Save the program encrypted in your account
vault.offerLead: It is encrypted on your device, with a code you choose, before it is sent. Nobody can read it, not even us, and we cannot tell which sin it is about.
vault.warning: If you forget the privacy code, the saved program can never be recovered, and nobody can open or read it, not even us.
vault.codeHint: At least 8 characters; a phrase of words you will remember is best. Do not use your account password or a run of digits.
vault.acknowledge: I understand the code cannot be recovered
vault.saved: Saved encrypted in your account, and updated after every check-in while it is open on this page.
vault.lockedTitle: You have a program saved encrypted in your account
vault.lockedLead: Open it with the privacy code to merge it with this device and keep it up to date. The code stays in this page only until you close it.

errors.short: The code must be at least 8 characters.
errors.weak: This code is easy to guess. Choose a phrase of two or more words, or a code without repeats or runs.
errors.mismatch: The two codes do not match.
errors.ack: Confirm that you understand the warning.
errors.wrongCode: The privacy code is not correct.
errors.load: The encrypted copy could not be opened. Try again.
errors.create: The encrypted copy could not be saved. What is on your device is unchanged.
errors.save: The encrypted copy could not be updated. What is on your device is saved.
errors.reopen: The privacy code was changed on another device; open the program again.
